reason: Mostly sound and cheap: it is text only (0 GPU, no slot). The facts check out: #37 0.954 and #38 0.953 are ticked (poll.log); re-ticks are allowed until 23:59 UTC = 02:59 MSK; exp75 is #37's topology plus exp79a's CI coordinates (R25-A4), so 'exp75 carries only CI' is right; the mc26 ranges match the scan notes and are labelled as estimates. The split-lever logic is a real structural change after probe 50 (V_pub is now non-CI). It is not a closed line. Four defects must be fixed before it is used. (1) SIGN ERROR in the tie rule: 'файл, после которого нас обогнали команды' means teams overtook US. The UP test (CONTEXT l.3124; probe 50: rank 153->134, 21 TeamIds passed) means WE passed teams. (2) PRE-REGISTRATION CONFLICT: R25-A1 (5) (CONTEXT 11:17 UTC) allows pair B {V_pub, exp75} only at exp75 >= 0.955 and 'as a trade, never as the default'. The draft makes B the RECOMMENDED default with a 0.954 floor. That is legitimate only if R26F-2's amendment is logged pre-score, with the structural reason (V_pub became non-CI at 12:16 UTC). Logging it after exp75 reads (~09:00-09:40 UTC 29 Sep) would be post-hoc. (3) The fallback misses R25-A1 (5)'s clause: exp75 <= 0.953 or ERROR -> CI-risk flag on any CI V_pub (row 2). (4) Row 3 lists {основной, #37+K} (exp89u). That file is not built into experiments/ or scheduled, and R26F-7 ranks it below exp89s, so the row is noise unless it is submitted. Minor: the round prompt's 'Q3 open' is stale (the user said YES at 11:26 UTC, SEC allowed only in the V_pub slot). The card may state this, since a SEC stack can become V_nonCI. The value is model-conditional (a subjective mc26 prior on how levers transfer to private), but the card says so and the user picks.
fix: Before 23:30 UTC 28 Sep (the freeze; at the latest before exp75's submit at 00:06 UTC), log R26F-2 in CONTEXT as a pre-score amendment of R25-A1 (5), with the last poll header quoted: 'V_pub non-CI -> {V_pub, exp75} is the recommended row at exp75 >= 0.954, clean, CI-RAN (dL > 0.5 h); V_pub CI -> the R25 rule (>= 0.955, a trade)'. Then store the draft with these edits: (a) tie rule (1) -> '(1) файл, после которого МЫ обошли команды (UP-тест: он выше без округления; 0 обойдённых = не решено, не «ниже»)'; (b) fallback line + 'если exp75 <= 0.953 или ошибка: пометка «риск CI» у любого основного файла с CI (пара 2)'; (c) remove '{основной, #37+K}' from row 3 unless exp89u is actually submitted; (d) optionally add to row 1: 'файл с SEC допустим только как основной (ваш ответ Q3 = да, 28 сен 14:26 МСК)'. Fill the <> at the 12:03 UTC (15:03 MSK) cron as planned.
realistic_gain: Selection-level only; not an LB score gain. If the user follows row 1 instead of the ticked {#37, #38}, the model puts bronze at ~0.77-0.91 against ~0.48-0.66 (silver ~0.50-0.74 against ~0.10-0.23), about +0.2-0.3 bronze probability. These are subjective single-embryo priors, so the real gain is uncertain but probably positive. The fixes themselves change no numbers. They prevent a user-facing misstatement of the tie rule and a post-hoc breach of R25-A1 (5).
